Touch: left side = move (joystick) · right side = swipe to look · FIRE button (drag it to aim while shooting) · SPRINT for a burst of speed. Pause → MOVE BUTTONS to drag the controls where your thumbs want them.
Desktop: WASD move · Shift sprint · mouse look · click fire · R reload · Q/E swap weapon · 1-2-3 weapons · V camera · Esc pause.
Shotgun unlocks at wave 3, assault rifle at wave 6. Shoot the red barrels. Grab the glowing drops.
